storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
"Welcome to Lady Daffodil's Exchange Shop. We barter goods and collect heads. Our rates are perfectly fair—fair to all, no deception."

Amidst the swirling gray mist, the woman gently tapped the ash from her antique wooden pipe. Beneath the swaying brim of her hat, a flickering smile hovered at the corners of her lips, laced with ambiguity.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Daffodil sold herself to the Silver Core Research Laboratory of Mythag University at a staggering price.

Before that, the laboratory head Doll had repeatedly expressed strong dissatisfaction with the one-way communications that only Daffodil could initiate.

But only Daffodil and a certain deceased high-ranking member of Mythag University know how such a "one-way communication" was established through a dangerous transaction.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Daffodil's whereabouts at Mythag University are nothing short of ghostly. After all, she possesses taboo knowledge of interdimensional travel, allowing her to come and go as she pleases, entirely unfettered by Black Pool's Silver Core Hub.

She routinely deals in mysterious instruments and materials of dubious origin, and sometimes assists other Awakeners in briefly evading the oversight of Mythag University.

Later, through negotiations, she opened her own "Worry-Relief Shop" in a disused room beside the infirmary on campus.

Of course, all goods for sale must first be registered and vetted by Mythag University.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
On a street corner in a port city sat a tiny exchange shop, run by a proprietor skilled in handling mysterious events.

Not long after the flood, Daffodil—who was not yet known as Daffodil at the time—arrived near St. Peidro. Soon after her arrival, victims of the "mysterious head disappearance" began to surface throughout the harbor city.

The owner investigated, tracked it down, and after exhausting every measure to subdue it, struck a bargain with it. The shopkeeper promised it her own head upon her death, but until then, it must serve as her assistant and could no longer hunt at will.

And so the creature, after a thousand years of wandering, began to work and live by her side.

It had once immersed itself in the memories of countless heads, tasting both fleeting joy and festering resentment. But this absurd happiness was merely a pastime to while away its prolonged existence, masking the profound, drifting loneliness.

Only while accompanying the shopkeeper did it experience genuine friendship for the very first time. It realized that infinite heads offered nothing but a hollow comfort; only true human connection could fill its perpetual void.

However, this brief happiness lasted less than ten years. The shopkeeper, who had never once set aside her work, passed away unexpectedly.

And so it severed her head, inheriting her appearance, shop, and name, becoming "Daffodil."

From that day forward, Daffodil embarked on a journey with her little exchange shop. She continues to claim heads as payment from those who seek her help, keeping them as private collectibles.

But she never hunted at will again.

Never again.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
In the gray, viscous Sea of Primordial Essence, emptiness prevails; the notions shared by travelers crossing dimensions remain confined to abstract descriptions and imagination.

It wants to confirm with its own eyes the "places of human yearning," to witness the magnificent wonders of the mortal world, and to experience the bittersweet nuances of human love and loss.

Yet above all, it desires a specific person, someone to cherish, someone to trust.

A fair trade means equality, detachment, and accounts settled—not a fraction more is paid, nor a fraction less taken. But it yearns for something different—an unconditional trust to bridge the divide, to break through cautious probe, to thaw the lingering ice.

It had found that, then lost it. But it would find it again.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content:
Hello, my name is Daffodil. I made an exchange with a guest who requested I assist you. So, let me hear what you require. 
Oh dear... what you wish for comes at quite a price, doesn't it?

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: So I will feed on this instead of Sepirot from now on?

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Delicious. Absolutely delicious.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: What do you want in return, dear guest?

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Daffodil's shop is now open. Children who aren't prepared, please don't wander in casually.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: My wares? You could say I have everything to satisfy all your desires... for a price.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Skull of Love, Skull of Resentment, Skull of Hatred, Skull of Desire... Oh, here you are again, dear guest?

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Since this is a transaction, I can't simply accept your gift. Would you like to choose something from my shop?

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: The extent of my contribution to your power ends here. Being too greedy is not a good thing, you know.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: What do you expect in return from me? Anything beside lending you power in battles?

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Curious about my true identity? It's still too early for that. Just believe this: Every lost child can find their way in my shop. Perhaps that includes you as well?

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: You are a delightful guest; even I am captivated by your unique skull... If you ever consider parting with it, be sure to visit my little shop. Haha... just a jest.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Oh, curious about my secret? This name, this body, this face, this voice—they all came from a woman from San Pedro, to whom one of my skulls once belonged. She struck a deal with me... After her death, I became her. As for her whereabouts... well, that is my most exquisite collection, you know.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: I wasn't always like this; she gave me a new life. In that sense, you have also given me a second life, so I will treasure your head as well.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Seeing how hard you're working, I almost feel guilty about collecting my reward too soon. So, I'll allow your head to stay where it is for now. But don't forget, it's already reserved as my personal property, okay?

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Hmm? Are you interested in me? Then I suppose... you're also ready to pay the price?

daily.title: Chat: About Caecus
daily.content: Oh dear, no returns on items sold here! You do need a submarine to dive into the deep seas, don't you?

daily.title: Chat: About Winkle
daily.content: That lady with heavy dark circles once consulted me about "living forever in the sun"... She only needed to migrate between two dimensions. Yet, she refuses to step into the Dimension Tunnel. It was truly a headache.

daily.title: Chat: About Goliath
daily.content: Oh, how can there be such an arrogant guest, wanting "the most powerful weapon in the world"? I told him it would take a head soaked in hatred to exchange for it, and he walked away sullenly...

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: A method to heal Dissolution? Such a thing doesn't exist anywhere. You ask how I remain uninfected? Hehe... It only takes "not getting seen".

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: My shop exists in any dimension, any location in the universe, and of course, it can be here. Besides, I like those careless children in Mythag.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I love new things. Over my millennia of travels, I have witnessed many fascinating innovations and inventions, such as poetic forms and cinematic scenes. Humans are truly intriguing creatures.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: I detest people who don't pay for what they buy. If you run a store long enough, you'll encounter this trouble. I have no choice but to handle it personally and get the due payment back.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: You are my esteemed guest. Remember, you're the only one allowed to run a tab. After all, it's been years since I last saw such a perfect skull...

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Oh, do I need to display the items for you?

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: That was a decent skull for a trophy... Though it can't compare to my best collection, the thrill of the hunt is always exciting. Do invite me next time, too.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: The passage of millennia has made me somewhat careless.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Behold your visage, O endless skulls!

traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase

traphase.title: Chat: About Sorel
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: I'm flattered, but no need. My little shop practices fair trade. If too many customers come in just to look without buying, I'd have a headache too.

traphase.title: Chat: About Ryker
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: If good luck could be a commodity, I'm sure it would be very popular... Don't worry, I'm not the kind of devil who trades in human souls.

traphase.title: Chat: About Jenkin
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Naughty little mouse, you'll be tied up and tickled until you beg for mercy.

traphase.title: Chat: About Lotan: Cetarchon
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: A hunter who stalks the wrong prey pays dearly for their mistake.

traphase.title: Thinking
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Hmm... This is a bit challenging, but of course I can resolve it for you.

traphase.title: Urging
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Excessive waiting time will also be factored into the commission fee.

traphase.title: Fatal Blow
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Behold the endless ocean of skulls!

traphase.title: Blunder
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Sorry, dear customer; I won't charge you for the part where I made a mistake.

traphase.title: Death
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: There are moments when even I feel powerless...
